title: Registered Mail in Canada: What It Costs
description: Registered Mail is $13.15 plus the letter's postage within Canada, with a signature, proof of mailing, tracking and $100 of coverage included.
keywords: cost of registered mail canada post
answer: Canada Post's price guide lists Registered Mail at $13.15 plus the applicable Lettermail postage, so a standard letter with a $1.24 stamp costs $14.39. The fee includes a signature on delivery, proof of mailing, delivery confirmation and liability coverage up to $100, with some exceptions. It must be deposited at a post office or given to a rural carrier.

rows: Standard, up to 30 g, booklet stamp
Standard, up to 30 g, single stamp

blocks.p: The $13.15 covers the signature, the proof of mailing, delivery confirmation and $100 of liability coverage, with some exceptions.

ul: A hard copy of the signature (advice of receipt) requested after mailing costs $7.25.
Additional liability coverage is $2.75 per $100, up to $5,000.
Canada Post says Registered Mail must be deposited at an authorized post office or given to a rural mail carrier, and can't be dropped into a street mailbox.
Registered Mail to destinations outside the United States is a separate price, $26.25 plus letter-post postage, with liability coverage up to $60.

blocks.p: Registered Mail is the right choice when you need proof that a letter was delivered and signed for. For ordinary correspondence it is far more than you need. [Registered versus regular mail](/blog/registered-vs-regular-mail-canada) sets out the difference.
